text:
anya.design: Pasted the updated Figma page for the dark theme experiment: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/Redwood-Dark-Theme-Explorations — please skim and drop quick reactions. I'm specifically trying to resolve syntax highlighting + chart color legibility for dashboards.
zoe.design: Looking now. First pass: background feels good (very low blue), but the chart line colors get lost on the surface when alpha is applied. Maybe increase chroma or add a faint halo. :eyes:
mike.eng: Agree on halos. From infra side we prefer not to do extra compositing in canvas-heavy charts; easier if colors have higher luminance difference vs surface. Can you provide the raw hex tokens so we can run a contrast check?
anya.design: Sure — current tokens (working set):
```css
--bg: #0b0f12; /* obsidian */
--surface: #0f1417; /* slightly lighter */
--muted-text: #9aa5ad;
--accent-teal: #2bb7a3;
--accent-coral: #ff6b66;
--accent-amber: #f5b041;
--chart-muted: rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
--code-bg: #071014;
--keyword: #7dd3ff; /* bright cyan */
--string: #f3b88c; /* warm salmon */
--function: #d9b8ff; /* pale mauve */
```
sam.pm: Quick product question — should the theme toggle label be "Dark" or "Night"? Also thinking: offer a "High contrast" toggle under accessibility. That extra mode could bump some colors automatically.
keiko.a11y: Please use "Dark" for clarity (users search for dark mode). High contrast option yes — that should increase text/color contrast to meet WCAG AA for large and AAA for UI where possible. I ran a quick check on --muted-text vs --surface: ratio 3.2:1 — too low for normal text.
accessibility-bot: Automated contrast report:
- --muted-text (#9aa5ad) on --surface (#0f1417): 3.2:1 (fails AA for normal text)
- --accent-coral (#ff6b66) on --bg (#0b0f12): 4.5:1 (just meets AA for 14pt+ / large UI)
- code foreground suggestions recommended for >7:1 for inline code blocks in dark theme.
luis.data: For charts I recommend palette changes to be colorblind-friendly. Proposed replacements: teal -> #00a69c, coral -> #ff5b4d, amber -> #f2a900. These keep separability and work well when converted to grayscale. I can run palette sim tests if you want.
zoe.design: Nice suggestions. Two visual alternatives: (A) bump achromatic contrast (text to 4.5:1) and keep accents saturated; (B) keep text softer but add 1px outline/halo on chart lines and code blocks. Which do we prefer?
mike.eng: Option A is simpler for us (single token change). Option B would require additional draw ops for halo which affects perf on the metrics graphs. I'd vote A.
anya.design: Leaning A too. I'll push updated token set — raise --muted-text to #cdd8dc (ratio ~4.7:1 on surface). Also will add an optional --high-contrast true that maps code tokens to more distinct hues.
keiko.a11y: Please also add an explicit focus ring color token (e.g., --focus-ring: #ffd86b) and ensure 3:1 contrast with adjacent components.
sam.pm: Copy tweak: instead of "Enable high contrast", let's use "High contrast (better legibility)" so it's discoverable. Also rename theme toggle to "Theme: Dark / Light" in settings panel.
anya.design: Noted on copy. I'll update the settings panel mock and push a small prototype — anyone want to sanity-test on a 13" MacBook and a 1080p external?
mike.eng: I can test render perf on Linux workstation tomorrow.
luis.data: I'll run the colorblind sims and post results here.
design-bot: Figma comment created on frame 'Charts — Dark v2' by anya.design: "Raised text token to meet AA; awaiting engineering perf feedback."
anya.design: Thanks everyone — I'll update the Figma file and tag people on the updated tokens. If you have an objection to Option A raise it by EOD, otherwise I'll prepare a tiny release PR for the theme tokens and docs. :thumbsup:
zoe.design: Quick nit — code block background maybe pick slightly warmer tint (#081216) to reduce perceived glare. small preference.
mike.eng: Fine with that. Keep us posted and include the code token CSS snippet in the PR so we can consume it in the component lib.
luis.data: posted palette simulation results: all three proposed accent colors keep >90% separability in common CVD modes. No major collisions.
keiko.a11y: Final ask: include an accessibility toggle in the theme docs and a short checklist for manual testing (contrast, keyboard focus, screen reader labels). I'll draft it and add to the PR.
anya.design: Perfect — wrapping up. Will open PR @mike.eng @keiko.a11y @zoe.design. Thanks!
